ps_ddr_bytes.derivation: Fitted PS DDR is not exercised by the pinned board firmware (OCM + PL BRAM only). Owner: board PZ1/PZ3 (U2).

ocm_bytes.derivation: Zynq-7000 on-chip memory is 256 KiB (UG585). The pinned bare-metal firmware runs from it.

evidence.source: pz7035-imx426 README and BRINGUP: 'ARM firmware runs in OCM, no DDR'; DDR size/type/width are unqualified

pz7035-imx426 README lists eMMC as present but untouched (U3)
Current board flow is JTAG into PL SRAM + ARM OCM; configuration is volatile. Production boot source/chain (FSBL, U-Boot, kernel) is an open board item (U4).

runtime.bare_metal: The pinned bare-metal OCM firmware is a diagnostic/bring-up baseline only. The C++ service graph (threads, HDF5, SQLite, filesystem) is not claimed bare-metal or RTOS portable.

native_plugin_abi.rule: In-process CPU processing-core ABI only. Its pointer-bearing structs are never copied into an IPC or FPGA wire format; an ARM native core is a separate signed artifact (linux_armv7) and its fingerprint must match runtimeFingerprint().

local_application_ipc.version_source: to be defined by E2 (versioned handshake); reuses the semantics of crates/mib-bridge/contract/bridge-contract.json (abi_version 14) for enums, IDs and outcomes
local_application_ipc.rule: Low-rate control/status only. Additive schema evolution, explicit incompatible-capability errors, 64-bit IDs encoded losslessly, bounded payloads; no native pointers, no FPGA register addresses.

ps_pl_wire.version_source: generated PS-PL interface definitions published by the board repository
ps_pl_wire.rule: High-rate result/DMA transport and register map. Shared application code consumes a pinned generated definition through the E3 execution-provider boundary and never includes board headers or register addresses.

ownership.failure_policy: Active run is finalized before release; uninterruptible vendor calls are TD-10

raw_sensor_bytes_per_second.derivation: 512 * 96 * 1 byte (Mono8) * 5000 fps = 245,760,000 before copies, metadata or padding. Distinct from result records and sampled preview.

evidence.source: epic #441 sizing input

raw_sensor_bytes_per_second.overflow_policy: Full raw retention is not promised; raw frames stay in PL unless a separate measured admission gate admits recording.

sustained_frame_rate_fps.derivation: Target schedule. Board evidence is ten 4-frame U-Net bursts at a 5000 fps input schedule from SRAM, not sustained sensor-rate operation.

evidence.source: pz7035-imx426 docs/PZ7035_UNET_BURST.md (short burst only)

sustained_frame_rate_fps.overflow_policy: Sustained rate versus finite burst length is declared per operating mode by PZ1; not sustained until PZ4 evidence.

evidence.source: #423 WP0 object-density envelope (U15)

object_density_max_per_frame.overflow_policy: Above the admitted density, results beyond capacity are flagged as loss in accounting, never silently dropped.

sensor_to_physical_output_deadline_us.overflow_policy: A decision that misses the deadline is not actuated; the miss is counted.

evidence.source: E3 with PZ2 record format (U13)

result_burst_capacity_records.overflow_policy: Required scientific records: bounded queue with counted loss (IncompleteLoss). Optional crops/previews: replacement.

ps_address_bits.derivation: Cortex-A9 ARMv7-A; no LPAE use is planned for the application.

evidence.source: UG585

ps_address_bits.overflow_policy: Stride/offset arithmetic uses 64-bit integers; file offsets are 64-bit (HDF5); no single mapping may exceed max_single_allocation_bytes.

max_single_allocation_bytes.derivation: 256 MiB: the largest contiguous allocation/mapping the runtime may request in a 32-bit process, leaving headroom for OpenCV/HDF5 heaps and fragmentation. Confirm against fitted DDR (U2) in E1.

evidence.source: E0 proposal

max_single_allocation_bytes.overflow_policy: Requests above the cap fail before allocation with a typed error; malformed lengths/strides are rejected before allocation.

evidence.source: depends on fitted DDR (U2) and DMA/CMA reservation (U16)

process_rss_budget_bytes.overflow_policy: MemoryBudget owners evict under declared policy; the process never relies on swap.

evidence.source: board PZ3 (U16)

dma_cma_reservation_bytes.overflow_policy: DMA descriptors beyond the reservation are refused; PL back-pressure policy is board-owned.

frame_store_ring_frames.derivation: FrameStore default capacity (include/backend/playback/FrameStore.h). At 512x96 Mono8 this is 25,165,824 bytes; the appliance value is set by E1 from process_rss_budget_bytes.

evidence.source: FrameStore.h constructor default

frame_store_ring_frames.overflow_policy: Ring overwrite is counted (storeOverwritten) and reconciles as IncompleteLoss for a run.

experiment_buffer_max_frames.derivation: ExperimentFrameBuffer::Policy default maxFrames (maxBytes 0 = no byte cap yet).

evidence.source: include/backend/processing/ExperimentFrameBuffer.h

experiment_buffer_max_frames.overflow_policy: Eviction under declared policy is accounted as persistenceCancelledByPolicy; a byte budget must be set on the appliance.

preview_rate_hz_max.derivation: Display replacement rate for the touch client; sampled from immutable preview transactions.

evidence.source: E0 proposal

preview_rate_hz_max.overflow_policy: Newer preview replaces older; replacement is never counted as scientific loss.

evidence.source: E0 proposal

chart_history_max_points.overflow_policy: Oldest points are dropped from the display history only; persisted results are unaffected.
chart_history_max_points.derivation: Bounded display history for the touch client's charts; sized for a 1024x600 panel and the ARM heap, not for archival.

evidence.source: E0 proposal

touch_response_ms.overflow_policy: Measured on target under combined load (E4); a miss is a UI defect, never a backend policy change.
touch_response_ms.derivation: Touch-down to visible acknowledgement on the thin client while a run is active.

boot_to_ready_s.derivation: Power-on to readiness evaluation available, with no actuation.

evidence.source: E0 proposal

evidence.source: ExperimentCoordinator finalization sequence; the no-UI fixture waits at most 30 s

cancellation_bound_ms.overflow_policy: Status and cancellation remain available during finalization.

evidence.source: watchdog period is a board decision (U8)

fault_response_ms.overflow_policy: Outputs inhibited by PL independent of the PS.

evidence.source: storage media unknown (U3, U14)
